svg.title: Internal notes: comments the customer never sees — SoftTrack web design mockup (#287)
svg.desc: A comment is read by everybody who can read the ticket, guests included. A comment is public or internal, chosen when writing it; an internal note has its own background and label while it is written and afterwards; and an outside reader’s response does not contain it, nor do the counts they see.
svg.text: Internal notes: comments the customer never sees
Two kinds of comment, impossible to mix up

g.text: SUP-7, signed in as Nina. Carlos, a guest, reads this ticket
Priya at Acme Retail chose Download all on the invoices page and got a zip with nothing in it. It has happened for three days.
We still cannot download September’s invoices. Is there a way around it?
Same account as last month: more than 200 invoices. Check the zip job’s logs before promising a date.
We are looking into it. Meanwhile each invoice downloads on its own from the list.
Read by the team, and by nobody outside it
can you confirm the limit is 200?
invoices. Is there a way around it?
We are looking into it. Meanwhile each invoice
downloads on its own from the list.

svg.text: A sweep test reads every route that returns comments as an outside
A mention that cannot be read

g.text: Carlos Rivera is a guest and will not see this
Post it as a public reply to reach him.

svg.text: Done when a comment is public or internal, the editor and the thread make the difference impossible to miss, guests, external accounts, request senders, share links, emails and
chat channels never get an internal note, the filtering is in the query with a sweep test over every route that returns comments, the default is per team, a note can be made public
with a history entry and a public comment cannot be made internal, and mentioning somebody who cannot read a note says so first.
